name: Nara
registryBasis: Nara City’s Asset Tax Division publishes a city-wide parcel-reference map (“地番図”) as CC BY 2.1 Japan open data, including shapefile boundary layers. The 2025-01-01 snapshot contains 414,023 boundary polygons. Three nearest complete sample polygons are valid in native EPSG:2448 and covered by the union of relevant official Nara City 大字界 subdivision polygons, confirming city binding. The city says the map is for reference and does not evidence rights or exact legal boundaries.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

source.name: Nara municipal parcel-reference Shapefile snapshot, 2025
source.scope: The retained three polygons are the nearest shapes from Nara City’s official city-published snapshot (native EPSG:2448; transformed to CRS84). They are 3,835.43–3,838.61 m from the exact WUP point and none contains it. Sample identifiers are only the source parcel-key field and source record number; no other DBF values were read. This is a non-authoritative city parcel-reference layer, not a legal boundary or title assertion.
